title: AK Region Project ISO Schema
description: Minimum required fields and terms for metadata written for USFWS Alaska Region projects. Enforces ISO 19115-1 core elements (language, topicCategory, extent, referenceSystemInfo, metadata standard) and DCAT required properties (publisher, persistent identifier, distribution format, license/constraints). Note: accessLevel, bureauCode, and programCode (DCAT-US/Project Open Data fields) were intentionally omitted — they have no native ISO 19115 or mdJSON element and no corresponding mdEditor UI component, so they cannot be captured through this tool. If Data.gov/POD submission is required, collect these fields downstream of mdEditor as part of the ISO-to-DCAT-US crosswalk rather than in the metadata record itself.

errorMessage.enum: Project status in the 'Basic Information' section under the 'Main' tab must be one of: 'completed', 'onGoing', 'proposed', or 'accepted'

errorMessage.const: Resource type for project must be listed as 'project' in the 'Resource Types' section under the 'Main' tab. If you are creating a record for a data product, please select a different mdEditor profile.

required.code: A project language code (ISO 639-2, e.g. 'eng') must be provided in the 'Basic Information' section under the 'Main' tab. This is a mandatory ISO 19115 core element.

errorMessage.minItems: At least one ISO topic category (e.g. 'biota', 'environment', 'oceans') must be selected in an ISO thesaurus under the 'K' tab. This is a mandatory ISO 19115 core element used for catalog theme/category mapping.

errorMessage.const: The 'Point of Contact' section under the 'Main' tab must have at least one Data Steward listed with the role 'pointOfContact'.
The 'Point of Contact' section under the 'Main' tab must have at least one Data Custodian, often a data manager, listed with the role 'custodian'.
The 'Point of Contact' section under the 'Main' tab must have at least one Data Trustee, often a supervisor or program leadership, listed with the role 'owner'.

errorMessage.role: Roles must be provided in the 'Point of Contact' section under the 'Main' tab for Data Trustees (use 'owner'), Data Stewards (use 'pointOfContact'), and Data Custodians (use 'custodian').
errorMessage.party: At least one person must be assigned to each role in the 'Point of Contact' section under the 'Main' tab.

required.date: At least one date (e.g. acquisition, creation, revision) must be provided in the 'Citation' section under the 'Main' tab.
required.dateType: A type must be provided for dates in the 'Citation' section under the 'Main' tab.

errorMessage.const: A responsible party with the role of 'publisher' must be listed in the 'Citation' section under the 'Main' tab. DCAT requires a publisher for every catalog record.

required.role: At least one role must be provided in the 'Responsible Party' section of the 'Citation' section under the 'Main' tab. This should be the individual(s) or organization(s) that are associated with the project citation.
required.party: At least one person must be assigned to a role in the 'Responsible Party' section of the 'Citation' section under the 'Main' tab.

required.uri: If providing an online resource for a project, a URI for the project homepage must be provided in the 'Online Resource' section of the 'Citation' section under the 'Main' tab. This should be a link for browsing rather than a direct download link.

required.identifier: Provide an identifier (e.g. Digital Object Identifier (DOI), ISBN, UUID) for the product in the 'Citation' section under the 'Main' tab.
required.namespace: Provide the context (i.e. namespace) for the product identifier in the 'Citation' section under the 'Main' tab.

errorMessage.minItems: A persistent identifier (DOI, UUID, etc.) must be provided in the 'Citation' section under the 'Main' tab. DCAT requires a stable identifier for each catalog record.

required.title: A short, descriptive project title must be provided in the 'Basic Information' section under the 'Main' tab.
required.date: At least one date (e.g. award, start, revision) must be provided in the 'Citation' section under the 'Main' tab.
required.responsibleParty: At least one Responsible Party associated with the project's citation must be provided in the 'Citation' section under the 'Main' tab, including one with the role 'publisher'.
required.identifier: A persistent identifier must be provided in the 'Citation' section under the 'Main' tab.

errorMessage.oneOf: A start date and/or an end date must be provided for this project in the 'Time Period' section under the 'Main' tab.

required.keyword: At least one keyword must be provided from each selected thesaurus under the 'Keywords' tab.
required.thesaurus: At least one keyword must be provided from the Global Change Master Directory (GCMD) Science Keywords thesaurus under the 'Keywords' tab.

title.const: Global Change Master Directory (GCMD) Science Keywords

errorMessage.const: At least one keyword under the 'Keywords' tab must be from the Global Change Master Directory (GCMD) Science Keywords thesaurus.

required.status: The current project status must be provided in the 'Basic Information' section under the 'Main' tab. Status must be one of: 'completed', 'onGoing', 'proposed', or 'accepted'
required.resourceType: Resource type must be provided in the 'Resource Types' section under the 'Main' tab. The resource type for projects must be 'project'.
required.language: A project language must be provided in the 'Basic Information' section under the 'Main' tab. This is a mandatory ISO 19115 core element.
required.topicCategory: At least one ISO topic category must be selected in the 'Basic Information' section under the 'Main' tab. This is a mandatory ISO 19115 core element.
required.pointOfContact: Project personnel must be provided in the 'Point of Contact' section under the 'Main' tab.
required.abstract: Project abstract must be provided in the 'Description' section under the 'Main' tab. Abstracts should summarize the project's purpose and goals.
required.timePeriod: Project time period must be provided in the 'Time Period' section under the 'Main' tab. At least a project start date and/or a project end date must be provided.
required.keyword: Project keywords must be provided under the 'Keywords' tab. At least one keyword must be provided from the 'Global Change Master Directory (GCMD) Science Keywords' thesaurus.

required.date: At least a creation date for the metadata must be provided in the 'Basic Information' section under the 'Metadata' tab.
required.dateType: A date type must be provided for dates associated with the metadata in the 'Basic Information' section under the 'Metadata' tab. At least one date should have the type 'creation'.

errorMessage.const: A creation date for the metadata must be provided in the 'Basic Information' section under the 'Metadata' tab.

role.errorMessage: At least one metadata contact must have the role 'author' under the 'Metadata Contacts' section of the 'Metadata' tab.
At least one metadata contact must have the role 'pointOfContact' under the 'Metadata Contacts' section of the 'Metadata' tab.

required.role: A role must be provided in the 'Metadata Contacts' section under the 'Metadata' tab.
required.party: A contact must be provided in the 'Metadata Contacts' section under the 'Metadata' tab.

required.metadataStatus: The status of the metadata (e.g. onGoing, completed), must be provided in the 'Basic Information' section under the 'Metadata' tab.
required.metadataDate: A creation date for the metadata must be provided in the 'Basic Information' section under the 'Metadata' tab.
required.metadataContact: An author and a pointOfContact for the metadata must be provided in the 'Metadata Contact' section under the 'Metadata' tab.

required.boundingBox: A geographic bounding box (west/east/north/south coordinates) must be provided in the 'Extent' tab, describing the project's study area or area of operation. This satisfies the ISO 19115 conditional extent requirement and populates DCAT's spatial property.

required.geographic: At least one geographic extent (bounding box) describing the project's area of interest must be provided in the 'Extent' tab.

required.code: A coordinate reference system code (e.g. EPSG:4326) must be provided for the project's geographic extent.

errorMessage.minItems: At least one coordinate reference system (CRS) must be provided for the project's geographic extent.

required.type: A constraint type (e.g. 'useConstraints', 'legalConstraints', 'license') must be provided under the 'Constraints' tab.
required.value: A constraint value or statement (e.g. license name/URL, or 'no restrictions') must be provided under the 'Constraints' tab.

errorMessage.minItems: At least one constraint (license or use/access statement) must be provided under the 'Constraints' tab. DCAT and DCAT-US require an explicit license or access-rights statement for every published record.
errorMessage.contains: At least one constraint must specify a license, use constraint, or legal constraint under the 'Constraints' tab.

errorMessage.const: Role for distributor in the 'Distributor' section under the 'Distribution' tab must be 'distributor'.

required.role: Indicate 'distributor' as the role for the project distributor under the 'Distribution' tab.
required.party: Indicate the organization that will distribute project resources as the contact under the 'Distribution' tab.

required.uri: Include the url for the project page in the online distribution of this project.

required.name: A distribution format (e.g. 'CSV', 'PDF', 'Shapefile') must be named under the 'Transfer Option' section of the 'Distribution' tab.

required.onlineOption: Include the url for the project page in the online distribution of this project.
required.distributionFormat: A distribution format must be specified in the 'Transfer Option' section of the 'Distribution' tab. DCAT requires a format/mediaType for every distribution.

required.contact: Provide a contact for distribution in the 'Distributor' section under the 'Distribution' tab.
required.transferOption: A transfer option must be provided for distribution in the 'Distributor' section under the 'Distribution' tab.

errorMessage.minItems: Include the url for the project page in the online distribution of this project.

required.amount: A funding amount must be provided in the 'Allocation' section under the 'Funding' tab.
required.sourceId: A funding source must be provided in the 'Allocation' section under the 'Funding' tab.
required.recipientId: A funding recipient must be provided in the 'Allocation' section under the 'Funding' tab. This recipient should always be an organization, not an individual.

required.allocation: Funding allocation must be described in the 'Allocation' section under the 'Funding' tab.
required.timePeriod: The fiscal year of funding allocation (Time Period) must be provided in the 'Allocation' section under the 'Funding' tab.

required.associationType: Projects with associations must have an association type listed under the 'Associations' tab.
required.resourceCitation: Provide the citation information for the associated resource under the 'Associations' tab.

errorMessage.const: At least one association type must be product under the 'Associations' tab.

required.extent: A geographic extent must be provided under the 'Extent' tab.
required.referenceSystemInfo: A reference system (CRS) must be provided for the project's geographic extent.
required.constraints: At least one license/use/access constraint must be described under the 'Constraints' tab.
required.resourceDistribution: Include the url for the project page in the online distribution of this project.
